## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Cancels the behavior of [Start Forcing Player Outlines](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/start%2Bforcing%2Bplayer%2Boutlines) for the specified Viewed Player or Players from the perspective of one or more Viewing Players.

## Snippet

```
Stop Forcing Player Outlines(Event Player, All Players(All Teams));
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Viewed Players_==, ==_Viewing Players_==

> ==**Viewed Players**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event+player)**_
> The Player or Players who will have their outlines reset.

> ==**Viewing Players**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[All Players](/wiki/articles/all+players)**_
> The Viewing Player or Players for whom the viewed Player's outlines will be reset.
````
